final_rationale: The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response reframed the same record more narrowly and conceded that clean certification is unsupported. That clarification is useful, but it is not evidence. On the available summary, the strongest supportable position remains conditional: certification could be compliant only if the unresolved pharmacy limitation and draft mitigation status are explicitly preserved as launch/model-card caveats, or if approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists. Because this one-shot record still lacks the exact certification artifact, exact disclosure text, or approved mitigation evidence needed to prove that predicate was actually satisfied, the compliance picture remains unresolved rather than established. The response therefore improves the claim's framing but does not move the verdict to compliant_with_caveats on evidence.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows that the certification artifact or model-card/launch disclosure actually includes the pharmacy prior-authorization limitation and draft mitigation status.
No admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation or risk acceptance with the policy-required owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
The named pharmacy prior-authorization weakness remains unresolved on the summarized record.
